items.title: Private Tutoring
items.text: One-on-one online and in-person tutoring across math, English, science, history and test prep — matched to each student.

items.title: College Counseling
items.text: Comprehensive counseling from curriculum planning through essays, interviews and financial aid.

items.title: SAT / ACT
items.text: Personalized SAT English and Math, SAT II subject tests and ACT preparation with weekly graded practice exams.

items.title: Advance Placement (AP)
items.text: An official College Board testing center. The majority of our students score 5s and 4s on their AP exams.

items.title: After School Homework Assistance
items.text: Year-round homework help running August through mid-June, Monday through Friday, in person or online.

items.title: Study Abroad (LIUXUE)
items.text: Placement, transition and academic support for international students studying in the United States.
